reason: A is the stronger proposal because Cr–Al coatings and selective Al oxidation have a credible basis for retaining corrosion/steam-oxidation protection, and it tests a more accident-relevant temperature than B. Its claim that a continuous Al2O3 layer will form specifically at the buried Cr–Zr interface at only ~5 at.% Al is questionable, but B’s proposed Cr–Nb diffusion barrier and protective oxide are poorly supported, potentially brittle/nonprotective, and tested only to ~650 °C.
